Bill.BriefDescription: Extending state route number 397 to Interstate 82.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state route number 397; and amending RCW47.17.577.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.17.577 and 1993 c 430 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state highway to be known as state route number 397 isestablished as follows: Beginning at ((Piert Road in the vicinity southeast of Finely))state route number 82 at exit 114, thence easterly, northwesterly, andnortherly across the Columbia River, thence easterly and northerly toa junction with state route number 395 in Pasco.
